jobs.description: You will be responsible for managing the Agile Robots Group’s patent, trademark and design portfolio. Based in Munich, you will work across a group with production sites in Europe, the Americas and Asia. The portfolio comprises more than 1,700 files. You will be supported by an IP Paralegal and a Chinese Patent Attorney based in China. External patent and trademark attorneys handle the drafting and filing of new applications. You will coordinate their work with inventors, business teams and other internal stakeholders, and report to the General Counsel of Agile Robots Group.   Your Responsibilities:  Manage the IP portfolio: Oversee pending applications and granted rights, regularly review their strategic value, and instruct external counsel on prosecution, maintenance and portfolio decisions. The portfolio covers Germany, European patents (including unitary patents and national validations), the US, China, Japan, Korea, India and other jurisdictions. Develop new IP: Serve as the main contact for inventors, product designers and marketing teams. Review invention disclosures, assess them against business priorities and applicable legal requirements, including the German Employee Inventions Act ( ArbnErfG ), and instruct external counsel on new applications. Conduct reviews in-house or coordinate external specialists where needed. Support IP strategy and transactions: Contribute to IP due diligence, portfolio valuation and monetisation, cost control and the integration of acquired IP portfolios, including changes of ownership and representation. jobs.description: We are looking for a Process / Production Engineer to design the hardware that turns our process into a repeatable, scalable production line. As hardware designer, you will develop the equipment, tooling and fixtures for dosing, mixing, casting, curing and demolding of solid rocket motors, and take them from concept to installed machines. Good production equipment starts with a good process understanding. You will work at the interface between process engineering, mechanical design and the shop floor, and your designs will decide how fast, how safe and how reliable our production becomes. About us We're a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications. We are building our first production facility in Steyerberg, Lower Saxony, and are applying our knowledge toward serial production of solid rocket motors. We are working hard to build something truly spectacular. To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you're excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you. At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you're ready to rise to the challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Key responsibilities Develop process equipment concepts for dosing, vacuum mixing, vacuum casting, curing and demolding, from requirement definition to detailed design. Design tooling, mandrels, carriers, transport boxes and fixtures for motor casings and containers, with a focus on manufacturability and safe handling. Your primary responsibility will be to mature the physical installation of the electric propulsion system and guide the design from concept through detailed design and release. Create and maintain complex 3D parts, assemblies and installation models using CATIA V6 within the 3DEXPERIENCE platform. You will develop lightweight, manufacturable, safe and certifiable airframe structures from concept through detailed design, prototype build, test support, and production-ready release. Your work will cover primary and secondary structures, metallic and composite design and structural integration. You will work closely with Material and Processes, Systems, Production, Configuration, Certification, Safety and external partners to turn our aircraft architecture into robust, buildable hardware while mentoring junior engineers within your area of expertise. Create and mature airframe integration concepts, including interfaces to systems like landing gear, propulsion battery installation, electrical routing, interiors, etc. Work with analysis engineers to ensure designs are structurally sound, weight-efficient, inspectable, repairable, and suitable for certification. Create high-quality 3D models, assemblies, installation layouts, model-based definitions (MBD), and configuration-controlled design data. Drive design-for-manufacturing for metallic and composite structures. Support prototype manufacturing, supplier reviews, structural testing, non-conformance resolution, and design improvements. jobs.title: Senior UX & Interaction Designer (m/w/d) | Industrial Software | Teilzeit
jobs.description: HappyOps entwickelt moderne Softwarelösungen für die produzierende Industrie. Unsere Anwendungen unterstützen Maschinenbediener, Schichtleiter, Instandhalter und Produktionsmanager bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit, von der Produktionsüberwachung über Qualitätsmanagement bis hin zu digitalen Arbeitsabläufen und KI gestützten Assistenzsystemen. Wir verfügen über ein erfahrenes Engineering Team, das unsere Kunden von der Anforderungsanalyse über die technische Konzeption bis zur produktiven Umsetzung begleitet. Gleichzeitig entwickeln wir uns zunehmend vom individuellen Lösungsgeschäft hin zu einer skalierbaren Softwareplattform. Was uns dabei noch fehlt, ist eine konsequente Spezialisierung auf User Experience, Interaktionskonzepte und intuitive Nutzerführung. Genau hier kommst du ins Spiel. Wir suchen eine erfahrene Persönlichkeit, die komplexe Prozesse versteht, sich in unterschiedliche Nutzergruppen hineinversetzen kann und daraus einfache, effiziente und konsistente Bedienkonzepte entwickelt. Dabei geht es ausdrücklich nicht primär um visuelles UI Design. Unser Team kann moderne Oberflächen mit bestehenden Designsystemen und KI gestützten Entwicklungswerkzeugen bereits sehr gut umsetzen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Frage, wie unsere Software funktioniert und wie Menschen mit ihr interagieren. Welche Informationen benötigt ein Nutzer in welcher Situation? Wie navigiert er durch komplexe Anwendungen? Welche Aktionen müssen unmittelbar verfügbar sein? Wie lassen sich mehrstufige Arbeitsabläufe vereinfachen? Wie vermeiden wir unnötige Klicks, Medienbrüche und kognitive Belastung? Du arbeitest direkt mit unserem Gründerteam und unseren Software Engineers zusammen und prägst die User Experience unserer wachsenden Softwareplattform. Wir suchen ausdrücklich eine erfahrene Person, die eigenständig UX Konzepte entwickeln und fundierte Produktentscheidungen treffen kann. jobs.title: 2D Graphic and Motion Designer
jobs.description: About us Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ About the role We are looking for a designer with strong motion, graphic, and AI skills to join our performance marketing (UA) team. AI is a core part of how we make ads, but it works alongside classic motion design, graphic design, and video editing. In this role, you’ll generate static and video footage with AI tools and bring them to a final result. You’ll work closely with the Lead Designer and Creative Producers on advertising campaigns across multiple platforms, turning ideas and performance data into creatives that scale. Key Responsibilities Create static and video ads for our products on Meta, TikTok, and YouTube. Create static and video ads from concept to final result, using AI tools to speed up production. Stay up to date with Instagram and TikTok trends and adapt them into ad creatives. Generate AI video and images, and build AI workflows that speed up production. Propose your own ideas in creative team meetings. Qualifications 3+ years of experience as a 2D Graphic and Motion Designer. Proficiency in Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, Premiere Pro, and Figma. Strong skills in static graphics, motion design, and video editing. Solid knowledge of color theory, composition, and typography. Hands-on experience with AI image and video generators (Nano Banana, GPT, Seedance, Kling). Creativity and the ability to generate and develop new ideas. English language proficiency at B2 level. Portfolio showing your graphic and motion work, including AI-generated content (required). Nice to have Experience in performance marketing, in a product company or digital agency.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager – Server-Driven UI (Codeless)
jobs.description: Our Global Structure Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team. About the role We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead Codeless, our internal Server-Driven UI (SDUI) platform team. In this role, you will lead a cross-functional team bridging mobile/web frontend engineering and core platform backend systems. While this role is deeply rooted in modern UI architecture, its mission goes beyond standard UI development: Codeless empowers product teams across the organization to ship dynamic, native UI experiences dynamically from the backend—eliminating app store release bottlenecks, dramatically accelerating feature iteration, and establishing a unified UI schema across iOS, Android, and Web. What you’ll be doing This is a role with broad impact, from hands-on technical guidance to championing web and mobile accessibility across the company. We re looking for a leader who excels at fostering collaboration and can confidently guide a concept from initial idea to robust implementation. Day-to-day in this role you’ll: Team Leadership & Strategy: Build, mentor, and scale an engineering team responsible for our core Server-Driven UI platform ("Codeless"). Foster an inclusive, high-ownership engineering culture. Platform Architecture & Evolution: Oversee the design and evolution of dynamic layout engines, declarative UI schemas, and client rendering frameworks across iOS, Android, and Web. jobs.title: Staff Product Designer
jobs.description: Hi! I'm Chris , head of Product Design at Ashby . We're looking for a versatile, intrinsically motivated designer who is excited to contribute to rethinking how modern software is designed. At Ashby, you'll be part designer, part product manager, part consultant, and part design system manager (or some combination of the 4!). We do design differently here, and if that excites you, read on. Our unique approach is working - we're growing >100% year-over-year and have notable customers like Notion, Linear, Shopify, and Snowflake. Our growth and retention metrics are best-in-class among our peers: we have tens of millions in ARR, very low churn, and many years of runway. We're backed by amazing investors like Y Combinator, Elad Gil, Lachy Groom, and many more! We’ll share more details once we meet. How We Work In my previous roles, product teams always consisted of a product manager, a designer, and ~4-5 engineers. This may sound familiar to you! The product manager briefs the designer who then designs. After designing, mocks are handed to the engineers. We take a more principled approach here at Ashby. If you've been designing software enough, you'll realize in actuality, design is required in varying degrees on each project. Sometimes in the past, I'd be asked to design yet another settings page, when really all that was needed was an engineer to reuse existing components and just follow some documentation I had written. Other times, I felt I should effectively be the product manager and own a project from beginning to end. In these latter cases, it made sense that I was even the one providing project updates and managing resources rather than constantly being pinged by a separate product manager. This principled approach is now what we do here, and it is part of what has allowed Ashby to take down incumbents in multiple verticals all at once. We don't settle for the status quo—we actively resist reversion to the mean. Currently, I report to Benji, the co-founder & CE
